errors.evidence: The description states that the "бензин" (gasoline) sector is colored red ("червено"), but in the chart, it is colored orange.
The description states that the "хибридни" (hybrid) sector is gray ("сиво"), but it is yellow in the chart. The gray sector actually represents "електрически" (electric).
The description states that the "електрически" (electric) sector is dark blue ("тъмносиньо"), but it is gray in the chart. The dark blue sector corresponds to "plug-n хибрид".
The description states that the "Plug-n хибрид" sector is yellow ("жълто"), but it is dark blue in the chart. The yellow sector corresponds to "хибридни" (hybrid).

errors.text_span: Секторите са подредени визуално в низходящ ред по размер, като започват от „бензин“ в горната част и завършват с „други“ в долната част.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that the sectors are arranged in descending order of size. The actual clockwise order of the sectors does not follow a size-based sorting (e.g., 'дизел' with 12.70% is followed by 'бензин' with 34.40%, which is then followed by 'електрически' with 14.40%).
